verdict.sentence: Slightly murky, 70°F water, calm this morning.

clarity.label: Slightly murky
clarity.note: Last clear view: over a week ago. 2 cloudy passes since.

ice.caveat: Ice thickness is an estimate from air temperature, not a measurement. Check the ice yourself before going on it.

days.summary: Best bite 4:15 pm to 6:00 pm (sunset and moonset). Also good 6:30 am to 8:45 am.
